notes.title: v1.05 - Better achievement checking, reduced rank requirements
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] In some cases, lifetime score achievements weren't correctly being triggered. That should be fixed now. 
[*] Reduced requirements for unlockable ships and powerups. You may see a bunch of new things unlocked.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.04 Achievements Fixed
notes.notes: v1.04 Changed the location of Steamwork libraries and added a check at the launch of the game to retry getting all achievements in case any where mixed.

notes.title: v1.03 Update - Better enemy follow behavior
notes.notes:
